plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
Sell METU to reduce concentrated tech.
Trim SPY to reduce single name concentration below 25%.
Add to QQQI to increase income allocation.
Hold a significant cash buffer for capital preservation.
Focus on low drawdown and steady, lower returns.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for low drawdowns. Expect slower growth due to reduced risk-taking.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to small positions.
Trim METU to reduce concentrated tech exposure.
Trim SPY to bring its concentration back within limits.
Buy AMAT, a high-scoring scanner setup, to add exposure.
Maintain a moderate cash buffer.
Aim for risk-first growth with a target of around 2.5% monthly.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by blending growth and risk management. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) as allowed.
Increase concentration in high-conviction tech (METU).
Trim SPY to manage single name concentration.
Add AMAT and AMD, top-rated scanner setups, to concentrate gains.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer to maximize invested capital.
Target aggressive growth around 4% monthly, accepting higher potential drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth (around 4% monthly) by increasing leverage and concentration in top-rated names and leveraged ETFs. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks associated with leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) and high-beta tech (METU, CRWD, SNOW).
Significantly increase allocation to QQQI for monthly income.
Trim SPY to reduce concentration and increase cash buffer.
Prioritize steady monthly distributions over growth.
Maintain a substantial cash buffer.
Focus on low drawdown and reliable income generation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly return through steady distributions, not capital appreciation. It minimizes risk by eliminating leverage and volatile single names, prioritizing QQQI. NAV can still fall in market downturns, but the focus is on consistent income.
